scenes.say: Same bean. Two very different cups.
Toss-tah-too-rah means roasting. Heat turns hard green beans brown. That's where the aroma comes from.
Light roast keeps acidity and fruit. Dark roast turns roasty and bitter.
Medium sits in between. Balanced acidity, fuller body.
Roast names aren't standardized. One roaster's medium is another's dark. Trust your cup.
Roast sets the flavor. Save this for your next bag.
